CLUE:\nYou can\'t visit Seattle without seeing me. I am the most iconic landmark in the city
Space Needle

The Space Needle was built for the 1962 Seattle World Fair. 
\ It has an observation deck at 520 feet and is one of the most popular attractions in Seattle. 
\ Fun facts from their website: It was built in 400 days 4.5 million dollars with the workers making an hourly wage or $3.92.
\ 5,600 tons of concrete were poured for its foundation, a nd it is held together with 74,000 bolts
I am surrounded by a lot of other gems like the fountain lawn and moPop museum.
Welcome to the Mobile Treasure Hunt
CLUE:\nThis iconic part of the skyline is a fun ride and also a great spot to grab some fish and chips
Seattle Great Wheel
The Seattle Great Wheel is a 175ft tall ferris wheel on Pier 57.\n\ A rather expensive ride, it does offer a nice view of downtown and Elliot Bay. It is the tallest ferris wheel on the west coast.
Not as impressive as the London eye, but a big improvement over state fair versions
CLUE:\nI would normally grind you bones to make my bread, but in this case I smashed some cars!
The Fremont Troll
The Fremont troll is a concrete statue under the Aurora Bridge in the Fremont neighborhood. \ It includes a crushed Volkswagon Beetle and was commissioned by the city in 1989
Hiding under a bridge in a hip neighborhood that also includes a Lenin statue, \ I am a quirky addition to Seattle

Precise Location Needed

These are the rules:
\ 1. When you click 'start' the mobile treasure hunt will begin and the timer will start.

\ 2. You will be shown a clue about a place in Seattle and will have to find it.

\ 3. If you get stuck you can ask for a hint via the 'hint' button.

\ 4. If you get close click the 'foundIt\!' button.

\ 5. If you are too far away you keep searching notification, otherwise details about that place will be shown.

\ 6. While you read the details the timer will be paused, but when you click 'continue' the next clue will be shown.

\ 6. At any time you can click the 'quit' button to return to the start.

\ 7. Once you find all the clues you win the game and your overall time will be displayed. Clicking 'home'\ will restart the game.Good Luck\!
